messages.subject: WC-00188 - your draft witness statement for review
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Stephen,

Attached is the draft of your first witness statement for review. Please check the technical points in particular: the no-permitted-excursion characterisation of HRX-118, the peaks (19.4C and 14.1C), and the description of the re-manufacturing campaign and its clinical-supply impact. Let me know any corrections and we'll finalise for signature.

Kind regards,
Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
